cloud_check_authority.truth: For the cloud dispatch path an authenticated remote executor is part of the trusted computing base. The coordinator recomputes the receipt's bindings — mission/task/attempt/plan/fence/policy identity, the exact publication envelopes, and the receipt-to-evidence digest — and does NOT recompute template_sha256, candidate_tree_sha256, output_sha256, exit_code, timed_out or cleanup_complete, nor re-run any check. A hand-built passing receipt with arbitrary digests is accepted at this boundary by design. Every successful cloud completion records check_authority: executor_attested in the committed task.completed payload, inside payload_sha256 and the event_sha256 chain.

cloud_unsupported_transitions.abandon: Disabled for this release. The route returns 501 ABANDON_UNSUPPORTED and never reaches the store, and connect_executor no longer calls it: abandon_dispatch wrote the lease slot, outbox and session but emitted no event, did not advance the head, and left the attempt and task RUNNING with the lease still counting against max_concurrency. A shutdown after a claim now leaves the lease to expire on TTL.
cloud_unsupported_transitions.multi_executor: Refused at registration with MultiExecutorUnsupported -> 409 MULTI_EXECUTOR_UNSUPPORTED. One mission-wide expected head means a second executor's claim would conflict at a random later moment; it now fails closed immediately with a named reason. Same-id reconnect still works and a session idle past the lease bound stops blocking. Cloud parallelism is NOT claimed anywhere.
cloud_unsupported_transitions.post_hackathon: The transactional-head redesign: the server reads the current head transactionally for executor operations, the client head becomes observation rather than mutation authority, and two interleaved sessions are tested against the emulator.

final_bundle_authority.truth: register_final_result_bundle fails closed unless a repository-aware recompute is bound, runs it, and issues a FinalBundleVerificationReceiptV1 into the FINAL_RESULT_BUNDLE_READY event. Approval, rejection and cold verification all refuse a bundle that does not carry a server receipt binding it exactly. The adversarial test that used to document the hole now enforces the fix.

graph_economics.truth: The equal-quality-gate, three-mode, non-overwriting harness has a credential-free unit test. No real repeated run, token/cost/latency result, median, or P95 is claimed. Deferred deliberately on 2026-08-25 rather than filled with a deterministic stand-in: the only credential-free driver (scripted-local) emits no token, cost, or usage field, so every economics metric would be "unavailable"; and a coordinated-versus-uncoordinated comparison built on deterministic scripted workers would report a conflict rate chosen by whoever wrote the fixture, not one measured in the world. Graphene's write-scope refusal is real and separately tested (tests/unit/orchestration/test_validation.py), but that is a mechanism check, not an economic result. Reasons, rejected designs, and what a real result requires: benchmarks/DEFERRAL.md.

planning_source_binding.truth: Planning reads the manifest from `git ls-tree -r -l -z --full-tree <base_sha>` and excerpt bytes from `git cat-file blob`, so the planner sees exactly the commit the workers clone and detach to. Tracked or staged drift from that commit is rejected by name before any byte is selected. No path under the repository is opened during planning, which removes the intermediate-directory-symlink escape by construction rather than by a stronger open().

product_thesis: Graphene controls which repository state survives parallel coding agents. Within one fixed plan revision, a goal becomes a fenced graph that preserves accepted sibling work, retries failed work, admits accepted artifacts only, and verifies the exact candidate. Policy may authorize an isolated result ref. Graphene never pushes, merges, deploys, or mutates the supplied checkout.
result: The current tree implements detached mission supervision, policy-bound authorization, private model children, selective higher-fence recovery mechanics, exact candidate/final-bundle authority, isolated local finalization, and an external exact-SHA artifact proof gate. Credential-free tests cover those contracts; current live Gemini, Codex, and cloud behavior remain separate and not proven.
